purpose: Re-expresses already-recorded D-013/D-017 provenance in the exact field names apc.evaluation.phase_d_seed_registry.audit_phase_d_seed_registry expects (bundle_seeds_evaluated / data_seeds_evaluated), so the existing, unmodified audit function can mechanically check a new candidate cohort against the now-already-used Phase D five-model cohort and its registered evaluation seeds. This file adds no new fact: every value is copied verbatim from docs/phase_d/PHASE_D_D005_SEED_REGISTRY.json (candidate_cohort.model_seeds) and docs/research/D017_REVIEW_RECORD.json (provenance.model_seeds, provenance.evaluation_seeds_D013_target_panel).
